components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per screen: Analyze, Run, Save, Upgrade.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; min-width:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:0.625rem; background:var(--primary, oklch(0.49 0.18 240)); color:oklch(0.99 0 0); font:500 0.875rem/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; transition:background .15s, transform .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:oklch(0.49 0.18 240 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid oklch(0.52 0.18 240); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside a primary: Edit assumptions, Share, Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; min-width:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid oklch(0.65 0.02 240); border-radius:0.625rem; background:oklch(0.97 0.005 240); color:oklch(0.15 0.02 250); font:500 0.875rem/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); transition:background .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:oklch(0.94 0.01 240); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid oklch(0.52 0.18 240); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Every form field; 44px tall, 16px text below md so iOS never zooms.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; color:oklch(0.15 0.02 250); } .ds-input { height:44px; width:100%; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid oklch(0.65 0.02 240); border-radius:0.625rem; background:transparent; color:oklch(0.15 0.02 250); font-size:1rem; box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); outline:none; transition:box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:oklch(0.51 0.03 250); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:oklch(0.52 0.18 240); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px oklch(0.52 0.18 240 / .5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color:oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); }

components.name: Source Chip
components.description: Names where an assumption came from: HUD FMR, FRED rate, TrueCap default, Your input.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:2px 8px; border:1px solid oklch(0.65 0.02 240); border-radius:0.625rem; font:500 0.75rem/1.4 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color:oklch(0.15 0.02 250); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-chip-blue { border-color:transparent; background:oklch(0.93 0.05 235); color:oklch(0.49 0.18 240); }

components.name: Metric Tile
components.description: One of the four metrics band tiles: label, mono numeral, signed colour.
components.html: Monthly cash flow+$554after all expenses and debt
components.css: .ds-metric { display:grid; gap:4px; padding:16px; border:1px solid oklch(0.65 0.02 240); border-radius:1rem; background:oklch(1 0 0); box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric-label { font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:oklch(0.51 0.03 250); } .ds-metric-value { font:500 1.5rem/1.1 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:oklch(0.15 0.02 250); } .ds-pos { color:oklch(0.5 0.16 155); } .ds-neg { color:oklch(0.55 0.22 15); } .ds-metric-note { font-size:0.75rem; color:oklch(0.51 0.03 250); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Dashboard rail row: icon + label, active row tinted.
components.html: DashboardNew analysis
components.css: .ds-rail { display:grid; gap:4px; width:220px; padding:12px; border-radius:0.875rem; background:linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(0.2 0.05 262), oklch(0.15 0.04 260)); font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:44px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:0.625rem; color:oklch(0.85 0.02 250); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; transition:background .15s; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background:oklch(0.24 0.05 262 / .7); color:oklch(0.99 0 0); } .ds-rail-active { background:oklch(0.24 0.05 262); color:oklch(0.99 0 0); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid oklch(0.62 0.18 240); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: TrueCap looks like a clean sheet of underwriting paper: a cool, slightly blue off-white page, dark ink, one electric-blue signal colour, and numbers set in a monospace face so a column of dollars reads like a ledger. Nothing on the page decorates; every colour that is not ink or paper carries a meaning (positive, negative, caution, action). The product surface is denser and quieter than the marketing surface, but they share the same ink, blue, radii and font, so a visitor who arrives from an ad and ends up in the dashboard never feels they changed products. The system is light-only by decision.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (electric blue, hue 240) for actions, links, focus and charts; green/orange/red are reserved for the sign of a number or a status.
Numbers first: font-mono + tabular-nums on every metric, table and ledger row.
Generous, calm rhythm on marketing pages; compact 14px/12px type in product UI.
Borders, not shadows, do most of the work; shadow-sm is the resting elevation for a card.
Every interactive element is at least 44×44px, enforced globally.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only colour that means "act here". If something is blue it is a link, a button, a focus ring or the active item.

rules.name: The Sign Rule
rules.body: Green and red are earned only by the sign of a number or a verdict tier; never use them for emphasis.

rules.name: The Always-Light Rule
rules.body: There is no dark theme. Do not wire the .dark tokens to a toggle or to prefers-color-scheme.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: A number that a user will compare with another number is set in DM Mono with tabular figures. Prose numbers stay in the sans.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: If a hairline separates it, it does not also need a shadow. Shadows appear on things that float.

dos: Do use the semantic tokens (text-success, text-metric-negative, bg-brand-blue-light) rather than raw Tailwind palette colours.
Do set every comparable number in font-mono tabular-nums.
Do keep controls at ≥44×44px and rely on the global :focus-visible ring; never remove an outline without replacing it.
Do render exactly one <Disclaimer /> per marketing page and define each feature name once per page.
Do keep text-base on inputs below md so iOS does not zoom.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent colour or use green/red for emphasis.
Don't add a dark theme, a kicker/eyebrow above headings, gradient text, or thick coloured side borders.
Don't request Plus Jakarta Sans at weight 900.
Don't use raw ; use next/image with intrinsic sizes to avoid layout shift.
Don't put text below 10px or reduce tap targets below 44px.
